events.name: John Hill: Silk and Loose
events.info: FRIDAY OCTOBER 2nd ****Recommended for audiences 18+ only. Graphic language and visuals, discretion highly advised. Sexual themes and explicit language. John Hill: Silk and Loose is an intimate, hilariously unfiltered solo storytelling show that unpacks vulnerability, aging, and body perception through sharp stand-up and confession. Sparked by an anonymous viral tweet speculating about his most private anatomy, John Hill embarks on a candid, self-reflective journey through his own sexual history, exploring whether we can ever truly control how others perceive us---and what it means to live openly and shed inhibitions as a gay man nearing 50. About John Hill John Hill is an accomplished actor, writer, producer, and radio personality best known as the long-running co-host of Andy Cohen Live and host of The John Hill Show on SiriusXM's Radio Andy. His stage career includes originating roles in Broadway productions like Hairspray (Fender) and The Boy From Oz (Mark Herron, as well as understudy to Hugh Jackman), along with starring as Jason in the cult Off-Broadway hit bare: a pop opera. Behind the camera, he has written and produced major television hits including Watch What Happens Live, Project Runway, Top Chef, and Kathy Griffin: My Life on the D-List. Recommended for audiences 18+ only. Graphic language and visuals, discretion highly advised. Sexual themes and explicit language.

Before purchasing, please ensure that you can attend the specific event, date, and time that is listed on the event page. There are no refunds/exchanges unless an event is cancelled/postponed.
